steps.name: Demo Home
steps.goal: Reach Home. If Apple Account Verification appears, tap Not Now. If the AI data notice appears, tap Agree and continue for this isolated demo fixture. Do not send a message.

steps.name: Group report offers Triage all
steps.goal: Wait for the agent's findings report. Do not tap anything.
steps.done: The report lists the group's open findings, with a full-width Triage all button above Edit schedule and Dismiss all.
expect: 3 PRs waiting on review for over a day

steps.name: Triage all asks first
steps.goal: Tap the full-width Triage all button at the bottom. Its accessibility label starts with Triage and execute. Do not tap Dismiss all.
steps.done: A confirmation asks whether to triage the group's findings.

steps.name: Confirm starts one triage for the group
steps.goal: In the confirmation, tap Triage all once. This isolated demo transport returns no session id, so no agent or real work starts. The error banner lasts about 4 seconds. Do not tap anything after that.
steps.done: The confirmation is closed and the group report is still visible: the failed launch did not leave the page or drop the findings.
expect: 3 PRs waiting on review for over a day
